scope: experiment-local error feedback and worker; no Lean, solver, network, trials, or paid APIs executed
compatibility: Shared harness/evaluator and old worker unchanged. Only structured failed-compile details differ. Status, valid, metrics, scoring, prompts, proposal budgets, verification and history logic remain copied.
archive_selection: First compile-failed environment in recorded result order, then first non-timeout nonzero-returncode run in recorded run order. Read its full UTF-8 log. Missing run/log is an explicit exception.
extraction: First located or unlocated error diagnostic, allowing optional Lean severity tags such as error(lean.unknownIdentifier), ending before next diagnostic regardless of severity or tag. Earlier warnings ignored. A tagged diagnostic preserves its full severity/code header in the existing message field. Location replaces trial root with <RUN>. First goal, its nearest preceding case and up to 12 immediately preceding local-context lines are retained. Missing standard diagnostics yields the archived message as a defensive fallback.

bounds.method: Clip values using serialized-length checks and binary search; never slice serialized JSON. Explicit truncated boolean.

tests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3: Imported test_subagent_trials, rebound its worker global to the local worker module, and ran its full unittest suite

review_fix: Optional parenthesized Lean diagnostic codes are recognized for every severity. Regression verifies a tagged first error is selected before a later ordinary error, with earlier/later tagged warnings excluded. Existing schema and field allocations unchanged.
